title: The Reality of Defeat
author: Stephen F. Eisenman
content:
In justifying the American attack on Iran a few weeks ago, Secretary of
Defense Pete Hegseth admitted it had nothing to do with nukes, ballistic
missiles or the shooting of unarmed, youthful protesters: "When someone tells
me for 47 years that they want to kill us, I think I am going to take them at
their word." If the 45-year-old former TV anchor remembered the Iranian
hostage crisis of 1979, it was via epigenetic inheritance.
